LanguageData.PFV_NotOperable: This group cannot be operated right now.
LanguageData.PFV_NoConsole: This group has no working steering console.
LanguageData.PFV_SourceLost: The operating group is unavailable. Weapon operations ended.
LanguageData.PFV_TargetLost: The target is unavailable or contact was lost.
LanguageData.PFV_KeepOperator: Change the operating group explicitly. Inspection does not change command ownership.
LanguageData.PFV_CannotFire: Cannot fire. Check the operating group, target and weapon status.
LanguageData.PFV_ContactLost: The inspected contact is no longer available.
LanguageData.PFV_ContactReadOnly: Observed contacts can be targeted using their known position and uncertainty. Unidentified contacts do not expose entity details or entity focus.
LanguageData.PFV_MapUnavailable: Cannot enter map: the group cannot be operated or the map was unloaded.
LanguageData.PFV_TargetShortcut: Shift+click: set target and keep the current inspection and controls.
LanguageData.PFV_RadarTargetHint: Click this contact to set it as target.
LanguageData.PFV_NavigateTip: Observe a body while keeping inspection, operator and target.
LanguageData.PFV_BodyViewTip: Return to the current body without changing other interaction states.
LanguageData.PFV_DisplayTip: Instrument visibility, map relief and settlements.
LanguageData.PFV_FrameTip: Selected mode, then resolved frame. Click to cycle Auto, Inertial and Fixed. Auto uses Fixed near the surface.
LanguageData.PFV_OpenOperationsTip: Open the operating group's weapons without changing operator.
LanguageData.PFV_DebugTip: PFView debug settings and test actions.
LanguageData.PFV_Status: Inspect {0} · Follow {1} · Operate {2} · Target {3} | Camera distance {4}
LanguageData.PFV_PreviousViewTip: Restore the last valid view without changing inspection or operator.
LanguageData.PFV_ViewUnavailable: The previous view's object is unavailable. Keeping the current view.
LanguageData.PFV_ViewLimit: Group framing limit reached. Use Planet view for a wider view.
LanguageData.PFV_HelpCamera: Click to inspect; double-click to focus. Right-drag to look around; middle-drag or Shift+right-drag to pan in free view. Keyboard shortcuts follow your custom bindings.
LanguageData.PFV_HelpTasks: Click a fleet entry to inspect it or double-click to focus. Object actions contains Enter map, Set target, and Detailed status. The bottom flight controls handle manual control and maneuver queues. Opening the active ship's queue from manual control asks for confirmation. Enable fire control in Weapons, click a radar contact to target it, then check boxes or Ctrl-click to select weapons. Fire selected and Fire all skip weapons that cannot fire. In compact layouts, open Cockpit from the toolbar.
LanguageData.PFV_HelpSubjects: The bottom bar shows inspection, follow, operator and target. Inspecting another object or hiding details keeps the operator. Shift+click sets a target; open the operating group's weapon panel before firing.
LanguageData.PFV_HelpTime: PFView displays the current physics rate. Use the toolbar button or the pause key (Space by default) to pause or resume. Search and foreground windows take input priority.
LanguageData.PFV_HelpKnown: Unidentified contacts show observations and error only. Attitude markers: P prograde, A retrograde, R/r radial out/in, N/S normal/antinormal, T main thrust axis.
LanguageData.PFV_HelpLimits: Free group view uses 300 m–3 km distance and up to 2 km pan. Third person has a separate safe zoom range based on group size. Use Planet view for wider scales.
LanguageData.PFV_NoObjects: No visible objects match this filter.
LanguageData.PFV_InspectionLost: The inspected group is unavailable or contact was lost.
LanguageData.PFV_CameraModeTip: Switch the focused group's camera mode: free orbit / third person · hull forward / third person · velocity forward. Each mode retains its own pose and zoom.
LanguageData.PFV_SettingsFocusModeTip: Applies to future double-clicks and Focus actions. The current camera stays in place. You can also switch modes in the PFView toolbar.
LanguageData.PFV_SettingsStellar: Stellar rendering (legacy volume renderer by default)
LanguageData.PFV_SettingsStellarFast: Use the new stellar renderer (experimental; different look, performance-first)
LanguageData.PFV_SettingsStellarFastTip: Off uses the legacy volume renderer. Toggle precomputed photosphere detail in PFView Debug. On uses an analytic photosphere and thin corona with a different limb and corona appearance. Reopen PFView after switching.
LanguageData.PFV_SettingsStellarTip: The tier only applies when the new renderer is enabled: visual first = full quality; balanced / performance first lower only the corona sampling density. Legacy visuals are unaffected.
LanguageData.PFV_StellarHeatCache: Use precomputed photosphere detail (experimental, on by default)
LanguageData.PFV_StellarHeatCachePreparing: Waiting for stellar rendering and background preparation. Using the original photosphere.
LanguageData.PFV_StellarHeatCacheReady: Photosphere cache ready. Clear the frame samples before measuring.
LanguageData.PFV_StellarHeatCacheFailed: Photosphere cache unavailable. See the log.
LanguageData.PFV_StellarHeatCacheFast: This experiment uses the legacy renderer. Switch back and reopen PFView.
LanguageData.PFV_HelpCameraModes: Free, hull-forward and velocity-forward views remember their own poses. Hull-forward follows the tail; velocity-forward uses system inertial velocity and falls back to the hull heading at zero speed. Camera roll is stabilized by default; hull-roll following is optional in Mod settings. Third-person and planet views both cover a full circle; pitch passes either pole continuously with no angle stop, using safe distances and no panning. Look angles remain after release unless automatic recentering is enabled. Camera defaults apply on the next explicit focus.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_Assist: Stop rotation after releasing steering keys (off: retain angular inertia)
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_InvertWheel: Invert zoom wheel (default: forward zooms in)
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_Recenter: Recenter third-person look after releasing drag
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_Activation: Steering assistance, precision activation and scale apply on the next takeover; camera options apply on the next focus. Toggled precision lasts for the current control session and resets when ending control or switching ships. After rebinding, release held keys before pressing them again.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_ReleaseFirst: Release held keys first. Esc cancels recording.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_PressKey: Press a key or chord. A standalone modifier is recorded on release. Esc cancels.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_Overlap: This chord overlaps existing inputs and cannot be swapped directly. Change or clear the conflicting binding first.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_Conflict: Conflicts with "{0}". Swap bindings or cancel this edit.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_NativeConflict: Conflicts with the native "{0}" binding. Choose another chord or change the native key settings.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_NoThrust: No thrust is currently available in the requested direction; check engines, propellant and action groups.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_TranslateKeys: Fore/aft {0}/{1} · Left/right {2}/{3} · Up/down {4}/{5} (release stops thrust; velocity is retained)
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_CameraKeys: Right-drag looks around; middle-drag or Shift+right-drag pans in free view. Wheel zooms. Reset {0}; controlled ship {1}.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_Suspended: Input suspended: release held keys before pressing them again.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_ExitHint: Esc ends piloting. Effective manual commands take over and clear the maneuver queue.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_PanelHint: Esc closes this panel. Use the dedicated button to end piloting.
LanguageData.PFV_Pilot_ConfigNormalized: {0} invalid or duplicate bindings were repaired or disabled. Check the current bindings.
LanguageData.PFV_TimeUnrestricted: Using your selected space time rate
LanguageData.PFV_FleetEstimateTip: Reference Δv uses the existing group propulsion estimate and does not guarantee mission completion. Environment-dependent networks show the shortest full-thrust endurance under current conditions; see details for individual propellants. Node countdowns refer to the node time; ignition can be earlier. Propellant below 20% is only a reserve reminder.
LanguageData.PFV_FleetUnloadedMaps: Some interior maps are unloaded; building and weapon counts cover loaded maps only.
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitSwitchManual: End manual control of {0} and take control of {1}?
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitSwitchSource: Switch the operation source from {0} to {1} and begin manual control?
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitAutomaticConfirm: End manual control of {0} and open its maneuver queue?
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitFireSelectedTip: Fire the ready weapons among the {0} selected at the current target.
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitFireAllTip: Fire all ready weapons on the operating ship at the current target.
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitNoReadyWeapons: No weapons can fire at the current target
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitWeaponMultiSelect: Click the checkbox or Ctrl-click to add or remove this weapon.
LanguageData.PFV_CockpitSingleShotTip: Select one weapon that supports changing ammo.
